mapper.select: SELECT tc.cert_type FROM trainer_certificates tc WHERE tc.trainer_id = #{trainerId} ORDER BY tc.created_at DESC

SELECT t.training_id AS trainingId, t.title AS title, t.level AS level, t.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, COALESCE(t.price, 0) AS price, COALESCE(t.average_rating, 0) AS averageRating FROM trainings t WHERE t.trainer_id = #{trainerId} AND t.approval_status = '승인' ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
